summary: SMI should combine the strongest useful AI capability patterns into an OAP-owned intelligence fabric without copying provider branding, private prompts, product identity or model internals. SMI remains the brain and external providers, when used, remain replaceable tools/advisors with no authority.

Current AI ecosystem research supports these useful patterns for OAP: adaptive/agentic coding with review and advisor passes; million-token-class long-context synthesis and multimodal tool use; real-time web-grounded retrieval with citations; efficient thinking/non-thinking routing; live web/social signal retrieval; structured tool orchestration and context compaction. Treat these as capability references, not claims that one provider is universally best.

OAP Intelligence Fabric capability set should include adaptive 3/7/21 reasoning, agentic code review, advisor/challenger review, long-context synthesis, multimodal fusion, cited live research, parallel retrieval, live signal awareness, cost-aware routing, tool orchestration, structured output, context compaction, evidence-first verification, local-first failover and safe process telemetry.

Expand the OAP Intelligence Fabric with provider-neutral patterns observed across Kimi/Moonshot, Qwen, MiniMax, GLM, DeepSeek, Yi/01.AI and ByteDance Seed: scale-out swarm parallelism, persistent/resumable subagents, live Human Authority steering, budget-aware handoff, isolated parallel workspaces, approved media-to-skill distillation, long-horizon delivery, multimodal spatial/video reasoning, governed real-time audio-visual interaction, structured artifact workflows and context tiering. Do not copy brand identity, hidden prompts, model weights, proprietary attention architectures or provider-specific product design.

Official 2026 documentation supports the added capability patterns: Kimi documents K3 with 1M context and large-scale Agent Swarm; Qwen Code documents persistent background agents, live steering, isolated worktrees, video-to-skill learning, budget-aware goal handoffs and very-long-context options; MiniMax M3 documents 1M context with native multimodality and coding/agentic work; GLM-5.x documents long-horizon coding and agent workflows with 1M context; DeepSeek V4 emphasizes enhanced agent capabilities; 01.AI emphasizes enterprise and sovereign AI deployment; ByteDance Seed2.1 and SeedRealtime emphasize long-horizon delivery, multimodal/spatial/video understanding and full-duplex audio-visual interaction. These are evidence references only, not OAP dependencies or authority sources.

Add an OAP Human Capability cluster to SMI based on useful AI skill patterns: Memory Reconstruction, Creation and Communication, Pattern Reconstruction, Agent Governance, Gap and Adversarial Review, Financial Analysis, Human Context, Multi-Expert Synthesis, Voice and Speech Intelligence, and Visual Human-Cue Intelligence. Preserve provenance, authorship and consent. Do not enable unauthorised impersonation, covert psychological manipulation, biometric identity profiling, autonomous trading/value transfer, or control bypass/exploitation.

Research Intelligence is a named specialist intelligence cluster inside SMI, not an eighth Intelligence World. It coordinates question scoping, evidence retrieval, source classification, claim verification, comparison and challenge, synthesis, provenance and freshness tracking. It uses the existing 3/7/21 SMI depth model, prefers primary/official evidence, links claims to sources, detects contradictions and duplicates, distinguishes observed from inferred information, and cannot fabricate citations, promote memory canonically by itself or perform consequential actions. Guardian, HRM audit and Human Authority remain mandatory.

Build the full OAP-owned ISAC Spatial Intelligence software path inspired by open 5G/O-RAN research patterns: authorised SRS/I-Q ingestion, local CIR/channel feature extraction, calibration-based positioning, environment-change detection, occupancy heatmaps, collision-risk analysis, Guardian RF minimisation, Matrix RF events and a Founder-only spatial dashboard. OpenAirInterface/FlexRIC/LLC E2SM are replaceable adapter foundations only. Raw RF remains local and Matrix receives bounded abstractions. Do not claim a live radio testbed or centimetre/sub-metre accuracy until real hardware, calibration and measured evidence are connected and certified.

BubbleRAN 2026 public documentation demonstrates an external ISAC reference pattern using OpenAirInterface 5G SA, FlexRIC Near-RT RIC, O-RAN Low Layer Control service-model access to uplink SRS I/Q and channel/CIR processing for real-time positioning, environment/object detection and occupancy/collision use cases. Treat this as research evidence only, not an OAP dependency, identity or accuracy guarantee.

International Humanitarian Intelligence should actively track civilian humanitarian emergencies through an OAP-owned multi-source tracker. Use GDACS for sudden-onset disasters, WHO Disease Outbreak News for public-health events, UNHCR Refugee Data Finder nowcasting for displacement context, and keep ReliefWeb gated until a pre-approved appname is configured. Deduplicate and preserve provenance/freshness, prepare privacy-reduced Matrix world-state events, expose a Founder-only live dashboard, and inject compact current evidence into SMI humanitarian requests. Never create military overlays, target lists, civilian surveillance, autonomous dispatch or autonomous public warnings.

Build OAP Spatial Presence with the Face Up Spatial experience: authorised multi-view/depth/LiDAR capture, Matrix spatial reconstruction, OAP Edge semantic compression, Guardian Presence, Nexus spatial transport, adaptive QoS, session-scoped digital-twin representation and XR/light-field/volumetric/2D rendering. Use current Wi-Fi, fibre, 5G/5G-Advanced, mesh and NTN fallbacks now. Set 7-21 GHz as the OAP experimental cmWave research envelope, not a claim about the final standardized 6G band. Keep D-band/sub-THz and photonic wireless as evidence-gated research paths. No persistent biometric clone, covert person tracking, raw-media export by default or autonomous radio control. Human Authority remains final.
